title: [POSTPONE] Hong Kong ICT Awards 2020 - ICT Startup Award
author: hkwtia
plainText: Dear Partners and Friends, We regret to inform you that all assessments and judging, along with the awards presentation ceremony of Hong Kong ICT Awards 2020 - ICT Startup Award originally scheduled for 3 Apr 2020, has been postponed until further notice. Latest information of ICT Startup Award can be viewed at : https://www.ictstartup.org/ If there is any question, please contact Ms Kylie Li via (2989 9164, ictstartup@hkwtia.org).
